text_moore: Sɩngrẽ Wẽnnaam naan yĩngr la tẽnga.
text_french: Au commencement, Dieu créa les cieux et la terre.
text_english: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.

text_moore: Tẽng ra yaa zaalem la pãng ka be-a zugu.
text_french: Or la terre était vide et vague...
text_english: Now the earth was formless and empty...
